title: Console face library
what: The bmo-console-face crate of bmo-chat the console probe calls: a manifest read by the pinned bmo-ui release through Bun, and the contract route and headers as constants, at the workspace pinned version.

title: Text readings library
what: The bmo-text crate's readings the quick checks call: dashes rewritten as a person types them, wording checked against a glossary, and text judged English or not, at the workspace's pinned version.
